label: The logarithm as an antiderivative
subgoals: The integral of one over x is the natural logarithm of the absolute value.
A linear inner function contributes a reciprocal factor.

label: Integration by parts with logarithms
subgoals: Take the logarithm as the differentiated factor.
The remaining factor is often a power.

label: Logarithmic substitution
subgoals: A logarithm in the integrand suggests substituting for the logarithm.
The derivative of the logarithm supplies the remaining factor.
